correctness.rationale: Exact finite reconstruction enumerates 262 and 1,758 simplices, replays 126 and 878 free-face pairs with acyclicity, obtains Z9 and Z homology from critical cells, and computes a 112-by-39 integral cycle matrix with all 39 nonzero Smith factors equal to 1. Eight natural hexagon cycles plus a primitive 20-triangle cycle are a full integral basis modulo thirty tetrahedron boundaries. The radius-three integral cocycle pairs -1 with the last cycle, giving integral surjectivity; 48 signed group-element Lefschetz checks and literal facet-chain transformations prove the W-module exact sequence.
